title: Cardinal Point Rental Network and Receipt Reimbursement Terms
content:
Rental Reimbursement Coverage benefits reach the rental in one of two ways: a network rental agency bills the company directly, or the named insured is reimbursed on receipts. These terms are identical under every Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement package ($20/$600, $25/$750, $30/$900, $40/$1,200, $50/$1,500 and $60/$1,800).

## 1. Network rentals

1.1 Network rental agencies bill the company directly.
1.2 A rental authorization must be issued before a network rental starts.
1.3 A rental authorization is issued through two channels: phone and the claims portal.
1.4 The rental must be picked up within 7 calendar days after the authorization.
1.5 A network agency may deliver the rental to the repair facility.
1.6 Network rental invoices are paid on weekly invoices for the days used.

## 2. Reimbursement to the named insured

2.1 Itemized receipts are required for any reimbursement to the named insured.
2.2 Receipts for a non-network rental must be submitted within 60 calendar days after the rental ends.
2.3 A reimbursement is issued within 10 calendar days after complete receipts.

## 3. Who is paid

The network agency is paid directly; otherwise the named insured is paid on receipts.

## 4. Reversal reasons

A paid rental benefit is reversed for one of three reasons: a duplicate invoice, an agency credit, or days outside the eligible period.

## The two channels side by side

| Point | Network rental agency | Other rental, or ride-hailing or transit |
|---|---|---|
| Payee | The network agency, directly | The named insured, on receipts |
| Before the rental | Authorization issued by phone or the claims portal; pick-up within 7 calendar days after it | — |
| Billing or claim | Weekly invoices for the days used | Itemized receipts within 60 calendar days after the rental ends |
| Payment timing | On the weekly invoice | Within 10 calendar days after complete receipts |

## Counting the calendar days (hypothetical)

- An authorization is issued on a hypothetical day A. Pick-up on day A plus seven is within the 7 calendar days; pick-up on day A plus eight is not.
- A non-network rental ends on a hypothetical day E. Receipts submitted on day E plus sixty are within the 60 calendar days; receipts submitted on day E plus sixty-one are not.
- Complete receipts are received on a hypothetical day C. The reimbursement is issued no later than day C plus ten.
